doc.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29

title: Earl Humphrey on the road, recordings and the Solace Green band
summary: The men discuss Percy's brother Earl, a drummer who toured and recorded with women singers, and a 1932 sighting of him.
